limitations: 1 kHz is a setting grid; absolute RF accuracy was not measured with a calibrated instrument.
Selected RF pairs and per-axis software grid coverage; not exhaustive RF Cartesian testing.
Both business directions share relay RX/TX LOs. TC uses T1 LO resources in time division.
ADDA bench service is armed for 600 seconds or 16 commands and requires maintenance rearming; GUI does not wake it automatically. Relay enable lease is separately limited to 5 minutes.
ADDA RAM reload reset UDP sequence; read-only maintenance queries restored continuity without relaxing replay checks.
matrix02 and matrix04 include rejected 29598/29600 and 29595/29600-byte USB uploads. Paced 460800 baud uploads are used from matrix05; no automatic RF retransmission.
No Flash/SD persistence, second-PC plan distribution or long-duration USB stability certification.
